# Contributing to ThinkPad Utility Management

Thank you for your interest in contributing! This project welcomes improvements, bug reports, and new ideas.

## Reporting Problems
- Clearly explain the problem.
- Add steps to make it happen again.
- If you need to, include logs, screenshots, or hardware information.
- When you can, use the right labels.

## Sending Pull Requests
- Make a new branch by forking the repository.
- Stick to the style and structure of the code that is already there.
- Test your changes before you send them in.
- Make sure your commit messages are clear.
- Start a PR and explain what you changed and why.

## More Resources
- Documentation for the project (if there is any)
- Code of Conduct (if it applies)

## What the Community Expects
- Be polite and helpful.
- Believe that people mean well.
- Stay on topic during meetings.
